description: This Java class 'ExternalId' is a value object used within the Fineract project to represent external identifiers with UUID support, including utility methods for generation, validation, and checks for emptiness.

classes.name: ExternalId
classes.description: A serializable value object representing an external identifier, with functionality for generating new IDs, checking if an ID is empty, and throwing exceptions if improperly used.

methods.name: ExternalId()
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the ExternalId with a null value.

methods.name: ExternalId(String value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ExternalId with a non-blank string value.

methods.name: generate()
methods.description: Creates a new ExternalId with a randomly generated UUID.

methods.name: empty()
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty ExternalId.

methods.name: isEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if the ExternalId's value is null, indicating emptiness.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfEmpty()
methods.description: Throws a PlatformInternalServerException if the ExternalId's value is null.
